reference_sql:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS DATE) AS order_month,
       COUNT(*) AS web_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE date_part('hour', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) >= 22 OR date_part('hour', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) < 6) AS night_orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE date_part('hour', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) >= 22 OR date_part('hour', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) < 6) / COUNT(*), 1) AS night_pct
FROM orders
WHERE channel = 'web'
  AND timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) >= TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
  AND timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts)) < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_month

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS DATE) AS order_month,
       COUNT(order_id) AS web_orders,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN date_part('hour', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) >= 22 OR date_part('hour', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) < 6 THEN order_id END) AS night_orders,
       ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN date_part('hour', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) >= 22 OR date_part('hour', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) < 6 THEN order_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(order_id), 1) AS night_pct
FROM orders
WHERE channel = 'web'
  AND date_part('year', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) = 2025
  AND date_part('month', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) >= 7
GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', order_ts))) AS DATE)
ORDER BY order_month ASC

solver.query:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT order_id,
         (order_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS lts
  FROM orders
  WHERE channel = 'web'
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', lts) AS DATE) AS order_month,
       COUNT(*) AS web_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE hour(lts) >= 22 OR hour(lts) < 6) AS night_orders,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE hour(lts) >= 22 OR hour(lts) < 6) / COUNT(*), 1) AS night_pct
FROM o
WHERE CAST(lts AS DATE) >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND CAST(lts AS DATE) < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY order_month ASC
